selected_script.angle: Optimizing a cramped home coffee bar station by mounting accessories on the side of a metal espresso machine or mini-fridge
selected_script.hook: Stop knocking over your coffee syrups and mugs every morning on your crowded coffee cart.

video_001_part_01.description: Show messy coffee cart clutter and knocking a cup over, then snap the rack on the metal machine side and organize bottles, demonstrating strong hold.

video_001_part_02.description: Hang tools on the bottom hooks, show the clean dual-rack layout, and display a light CTA text overlay.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Close-up of a messy home coffee bar. A hand reaches for a coffee syrup bottle and knocks over a ceramic mug. 3-6s: Hand snaps a matte black rectangular carbon steel rack onto the side of a metal espresso machine. It sticks instantly. 6-10s: Close-up of the rack holding heavy bottles firmly, matching the exact shape, lower front wall, high back plate, and matte black finish of the reference image. No CTA.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video continuing the previous segment. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-4s: Close-up of the bottom edge of the matte black metal rack. Hand hangs a coffee scoop on one of the detachable metal hooks. 4-8s: Camera pans out showing two identical racks stacked on the side of the metal machine, keeping the countertop completely clean. 8-10s: Clean text overlay appears: 'Upgrade your coffee corner today.' Keep visual style and product identity identical to part 1.
